paper_title: Axion search with quantum nondemolition detection of magnons
notes: QND detection of magnons with superconducting qubit constrains axion-electron coupling g_aee < 2.6e-6 at 95% CL over 33.117-33.130 ueV (~8 GHz). Uses rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3 and vtot=220 km/s. A more conservative angular-average treatment in the appendix gives g_aee < 1.6e-7 but main result is 2.6e-6. | Vision: This work excludes a narrow vertical band at m_a = 33.117-33.130 ueV (~3.31e-5 eV) with g_aee < 2.6e-6 (red vertical line). The exclusion is a vertical line spanning from g_aee=2.6e-6 up to the top of plot. The lower boundary of the excluded region is essentially the constant g_aee = 2.6e-6 at this single narrow mass range. DFSZ benchmark line read at midpoint.
